[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:383YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>Create Imperial Title ‘Patron of the Pavilion’, a sinecure with an income of 10 liao and 20 votes in the Synod. 

Elected by appointment of the League National Assembly. Privately funded by the benefactors of Highguard.

No civilian commission required.

''Proposed by Necropolis, seconded by Holberg.''</ic>
==Outcome==
* Create a new Imperial title following the [[In_the_garden_of_defiance#Pavilion_on_the_Lake|opportunity presented]] by the curse on Holmauer Park.
* Passed
==Date==
* Autumn 383YE
==Cost==
* Non-standard costs as described [[In_the_garden_of_defiance#Pavilion_on_the_Lake|here]].
* 60 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to construct
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Patron_of_the_Pavilion}}
==Campaign Outcome==
* Once completed this commission will be overseen by the title [[Patron of the Pavilion]] appointed by the League National Assembly.
